thread:
Sara (PM): Quick sync — we need to align on Q3 ServeScale priority cutline and dependency assembly. Customers (Beacon, XCorp) are pushing for private deploy + SLA. Goal: decide must-have vs next-wave features and launch gates by EOD Fri. @Noah @Tess @Kai can you chime in with blockers?

Noah (Eng - Runtime): For runtime, main blocker is KV-cache warmup for private deploys; cold caches spike p99. Target = p99 <= 200ms. Current private env shows ~320ms with 4k context. We can hit 200ms with quantization profile q2 + continuous batching, but we need: reserve 2 GPUs/region, a warmup script, and a canary model variant for fallback.

Tess (Infra): Reserving 2 GPUs/region is doable but expensive — rough estimate ~$420/day/region for reserved instances (ballpark). Also need VPC peering for Beacon's subnet and a infra change window for peering + route propagation. ETA ~2w if we open the networking ticket today.

Kai (Security): For private deployments we need KMS/HSM integration, key rotation policy, and the SOC2 checklist filled. Also require static analysis and an allowlist for inbound rules. Risk note: enterprise legal requires BYOK/HSM for encryption-at-rest; skipping it blocks contract signing.

Maya (Product Ops): Beacon's asks: private deploy (must), SLA (must), BYOK/HSM (must). They said realtime embeddings can be deprioritized. My recommendation: prioritize private + KMS + SLA for launch, push adaptive batching UX to next wave.

Noah (Eng - Runtime): Proposal: Launch cutline = base inference (text gen + embeddings in batch mode) + private deployment with KMS + model fallback to smaller variant for traffic spikes. Rollout plan: canary to Beacon region (1 day), ramp to reserved capacity over 2 weeks. Needs infra commit for 2 GPUs + network changes by 2026-03-28.

Noah (Eng - Runtime): Warmup script prototype:
```bash
# warmup inference cache
for i in $(seq 1 100); do 
  curl -s -X POST 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
    -d '{"input": "warmup text"}' 
    https://private-api.beacon.example/v1/generate >/dev/null; 
done
```
This reduces first-request latency and warms KV cache.

Tess (Infra): Agree with cutline but need finance OK for reserved capacity. I'll open FIN ticket FIN-742 to get cost signoff. Also need a network change window — pinging @netops.

Kai (Security): I'll draft security acceptance criteria (KMS integration steps, key policy, audit controls) and post here by EOD Thu. Will include checklist items legal needs.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ops note: add an autoscaling override that preserves 20% headroom during launch. Also add alert: p99 latency > 250ms for 15m -> paging. Add runbook entry for model-fallback route.

Sara (PM): Decision check: must-have for initial launch = private deploy + KMS/BYOK + SLA + canary rollout. Next-wave = adaptive batching UX, realtime embeddings, advanced cost controls. Owners: Noah(runtime), Tess(infra), Kai(security), Maya(customer comms), Sam(ops). Agree? :thumbsup:

Noah (Eng - Runtime): :thumbsup: happy to own runtime work and deliver warmup + fallback.

Tess (Infra): :thumbsup: will open FIN-742 and request network window.

Kai (Security): :thumbsup: drafting sec criteria doc now.

Maya (Product Ops): I'll prep the customer email and update the launch checklist with Beacon's must-haves.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for branch serve-scale/ready (build 4821) :white_check_mark:

Sara (PM): Thanks all — I'll create the project ticket with owners, deadlines, and link FIN-742 + security doc when available. Follow-ups: Tess confirm cost and network window, Noah post warmup script test metrics, Kai attach sec criteria. We'll reconvene next Tue if any open risks remain.
